 Greenberg: ‘Different versions of events’ Lehmann: ‘I didn’t know sandpaper was being used’ Huge wicket! Brook falls Broad reignites Lehmann feud Welcome to the MCG yesterday 11.43pm Australia win thriller to snap England’s T20I streak
 By Callum Godde Inexperienced Australia have pulled off a record MCG run chase to beat world No.1 England in the first of five T20 Internationals on home soil.
 In front of 39,289 fans on Saturday night, Australia snapped England’s seven-match T20 winning run by chasing down 188.
 Young allrounder Nikhil Chaudhary announced himself on the international stage, blasting a brilliant 66 off 38 balls and taking a handy 2-21 with the ball.
 Big night: All-rounder Nikhil Chaudhary. Getty Images Share Show more yesterday 10.49pm Great sign of depth
 By On a night an already inexperienced Australian side fielded two debutants, this was a good sign of the depth at hand. Nikhil Chaudhary was superb, taking 2-21 with his leg spin, including the pivotal wicket of Harry Brook, which ultimately derailed England’s bid to make 200 (9-187). In response, Chaudhary thumped 66 off 38 deliveries which, along with a promising knock from Sam Harper, got Australia home with one delivery remaining and three wickets in hand.
 Big night: Allrounder Nikhil Chaudhary. Getty Images 
 Share yesterday 10.43pm Edwards gets Australia home
 By The tourists bring the field in, but Edwards scythes a drive through cover to the boundary, locking in a three-wicket win. What a great win for Australia, coming after they grassed six chances in the field.
 Share Advertisement yesterday 10.41pm One more run 
 By Edwards punches a straight drive for two down the ground, Australia needing one to win.
 Share yesterday 10.40pm Dot ball
 By The third delivery is a dot ball to Edwards, Curran banging a slower ball into the deck.
 Share yesterday 10.38pm Edwards goes bang
 By Edwards clips Curran’s first ball off his hip for six over fine leg. Bang. 
 “That was such a bad delivery at this stage … it should have been wide of off-stump,” former England captain Michael Vaughan told Fox Cricket.
 There’s two off the second delivery, the hosts needing three to win off four deliveries.
 Share Advertisement yesterday 10.36pm Australia need 11 off the final over to win
 By Here we go. Left-arm quick Sam Curran has the ball.
 Share yesterday 10.36pm Jacks leaves the field … who will bowl his final two deliveries?
 By Paceman Crocombe, on debut, will need to deliver the final two deliveries of the 19th over. Here we go.
 There’s a single, with Edwards going deep, and the over finishes with Dwarshuis missing a delivery outside off stump. There had been a chorus of boos from the crowd, England taking far too long to get their field ready. 
 Share yesterday 10.31pm Blood on the pitch
 By Jacks (2-29) has dropped a thumping drive from the left-handed Dwarshuis, and appears to have split the webbing on his bowling hand. The team doctor is treating him. Play has been delayed. Australia need 12 runs from eight deliveries. 
 Share Advertisement yesterday 10.28pm Chaudhary departs
 By Nikhil Chaudhary (66 off 38) is given a standing ovation for his stunning knock after his leg-side flick was caught in the deep. His dismissal leaves the hosts needing 20 runs off the final two overs. Edwards and Dwarshuis are at the crease. And Edwards goes bang, thumping a six down the ground off Jacks.
